text: Poppy Playtime Chapter 5 speedruns are terrifyingPoppy Playtime Chapter 5 is terrifying, and fun to speedrun, so today we're speedrunning through the entire gaming Watch the world record speedrun by @lillemanla8662 here (I think this is the world record, will update if needed when the leaderboards are up though): https://youtu.be/6R_bTGS5xhs Watch the completely broken world record here (will also update this for a while): https://youtu.be/IxPI_nixKFE And this game is only gonna get more broken as time goes on, so check out the community here: https://www.speedrun.com/Poppy_Playtime_Chapter_5 Check out the new merch: https://eazyspeezy.com My 2nd channel (WEEKLY UPLOADS): https://www.youtube.com/eaziestspeezy My channel generally focuses on a more casual side of speedruns. With these videos I want to show off cool speedruns, explain how they work, and entertain. Hopefully you enjoy the content and maybe even take up speedrunning yourself, because it is truly a lot of fun! #EazySpeezy #PoppyPlaytime #Speedrun #PoppyPlaytimeChapter5
